prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Refine the supplied previous concept (Image 2), using Image 1 as the material/detail mood board. Produce a final Minecraft builder reference sheet, landscape 3:2, plain warm light background, crisp vanilla Minecraft Java 1.21.1 voxel blocks, skilled human builder quality. No characters or animals. Save-worthy public catalog artwork titled "PIKE PLACE / NORTH END". Exactly two views side by side at the same block scale: LEFT straight-on orthographic WEST elevation looking east/high x, showing the entire long Soames-Dunn streetfront and Butterworth behind; RIGHT elevated three-quarter view FROM THE SOUTHEAST looking northwest, showing both entire parallel elongated buildings, their roofs, the south ends and the long EAST/1st Avenue main facade of Butterworth. Do not call this northeast view. Small accurate axis legends: north low z, south high z, east high x uphill, west low x downhill.
Correct three defects of the previous image: replace the excessive staircase of garden houses with the actual predominantly TWO-STOREY Soames-Dunn commercial block; make Butterworth a long FOUR-STOREY parallel block whose ornate main facade runs along its LONG HIGH-X/EAST side, not a narrow end elevation; replace the enormous ornamental retaining podium and invented rooftop gardens with modest site-conforming foundations, exposed downhill lower levels and mostly utilitarian flat roofs. Keep successful warm wooden shopfronts, brown round original Starbucks logo, wooden door, Bavarian Meats beside it, paired upper windows, long dark projecting awning, modest flower boxes, red brick arched windows and heavy stone cornice.
Site geometry is mandatory: scale 1.4 blocks/metre. Both buildings run north-south along z, never rotated to face a camera. Soames-Dunn plot local x 0..59, z 0..158, height limit 69, actual roof maximum about y47. Butterworth local x64..117, z0..157, height limit65, actual roof maximum about y44; these are plot-relative lowest-ground heights, not instructions to make Soames taller than Butterworth. Main masses are long rectangular north-south strips, approximately 60x159 and 54x158 blocks, with irregular notch cutouts, not square towers. Preserve a narrow separation. Soames streetface is west/low x on Pike Place, Starbucks and Bavarian Meats side by side along z. Butterworth ornate main facade is EAST/high x on 1st Avenue; its west back is plainer with smaller windows and extra exposed basement storeys. East ground is about 8-11 blocks higher than west, slope mainly ACROSS x, only slight rise along z. Build walls continuously down to their actual stepped ground, never float or bury. Show lower floors as brick building walls with windows, not a giant detached stone garden podium. No terraces stacked into a hill of extra little buildings.
Footprint fidelity: Soames northern half occupies nearly full width with small eastern notches, southern half narrows on east to x43, then has a deep eastern courtyard notch with a separate connected east strip at x44..59, reconnecting toward south; west edge generally continuous except small southern setback. Butterworth is a nearly full-length 52-block-wide slab, west edge subtly set back four blocks in middle/southern portions, small north and south notches. All massing and decoration stays within those footprints, including cornices and awnings inset as needed. Represent these as restrained notches and service courts visible in the oblique view. The two cameras depict EXACTLY the same architecture.
Architecture: Soames two continuous commercial floors, brick piers with light stucco/sandstone infill panels, regular paired recessed rectangular upper windows, timber-framed big ground display windows and doors, readable "STARBUCKS" and "BAVARIAN MEATS" signs. Brown circular pixel-block Starbucks emblem, never green modern logo. Projecting dark slab awning with stair brackets, modest planter boxes. Butterworth four clear floors along the long east facade, repeated tall recessed arched windows on upper floors, brick voussoirs with pale keystones, pale sills and horizontal belt courses, deep layered corbelled cornice on long east frontage and returns. Plainer north/south ends and west rear. Flat dark gray roofs, shallow brick parapets with stone slab coping, a few brick chimney stacks and low stone slab vents; no pitched roofs, no roof gardens or invented skylight farms.
Exact material palette from mood board: minecraft:bricks, minecraft:brick_stairs, minecraft:brick_slab, minecraft:brick_wall; minecraft:terracotta for restrained stucco; minecraft:smooth_sandstone, minecraft:smooth_sandstone_stairs, minecraft:smooth_sandstone_slab, minecraft:cut_sandstone for pale trim; minecraft:gray_concrete for flat roof; minecraft:stone_bricks, minecraft:stone_brick_stairs, minecraft:stone_brick_slab, minecraft:stone_brick_wall for foundations/copings; minecraft:glass_pane and minecraft:brown_stained_glass_pane for windows; minecraft:dark_oak_planks, minecraft:dark_oak_stairs, minecraft:dark_oak_slab, minecraft:dark_oak_fence, minecraft:dark_oak_door, minecraft:dark_oak_trapdoor for shop framing and awning; minecraft:spruce_trapdoor for planter fronts; minecraft:lantern, minecraft:chain, minecraft:oak_leaves, minecraft:flower_pot, minecraft:poppy, minecraft:dandelion, minecraft:oxeye_daisy, minecraft:brown_concrete and minecraft:birch_planks for block-built brown sign and cream lettering; minecraft:glowstone hidden behind glazing. Use only real cubic blocks and legal stairs/slabs/panes/trapdoors, no tiny bespoke meshes or photoreal stone masonry. Dusk warm amber windows with subtle cool exterior lighting on a plain light background, no dark sky. Exterior only, shallow lit shop displays just behind windows. No extra buildings. Minimal clean headings under each view: "WEST ELEVATION — PIKE PLACE" and "SOUTHEAST VIEW — 1ST AVENUE". Prioritize clear long building proportions and correct orientation over decorative typography.

changes: Generated with the built-in image tool, inspected, and saved unmodified as concept-2.png in the current directory.
Biggest prior shortfall: excessive stepped garden-house massing. Removed rooftop gardens and simplified the roofs, although excessive stepping remains.

Biggest prior shortfall: Butterworth's ornate facade appeared on its short end. The prompt requested the long east facade; inspection shows the image still places the ornament on the short end, so site orientation remains unresolved.

Biggest prior shortfall: oversized landscaped retaining podium. Reduced its height and planting and introduced exposed lower-level windows, although the foundation still reads partly as a separate podium.
Preserved the brown round Starbucks sign, timber doors, Bavarian Meats frontage, continuous projecting awning, flower boxes, warm glazing, brick arches and layered cornice.
Added clearer utilitarian flat roofs, parapet coping, chimney caps and slab vents.
